//: A container, not vanilla's GENERIC corpse: `contains` gives it the container slot that is_container() reads (src/item.cpp:7765), which is what lets an item group put personal effects INSIDE it via contents-group.
//2: No CORPSE flag on purpose.  That flag sets is_corpse() with a null monster type (src/item.cpp:297) and puts the item on the butchering path.  These are things you search, not things you carve.
//3: 1 L holds papers, a wallet, a ring - and not much else.  Enough for what somebody had in their pockets, far too little to serve as a free rucksack.
description: Bare, unmarked and arranged by nobody.  Whatever happened here, it was not violent, and somebody has been through the pockets since.
